verdict.rationale: Canny's JavaScript SDK identifies users so that feedback they leave is tied to their existing user account (canny-docs-2), backed by secure identify requests (canny-docs-21) and a companies install (canny-docs-23). Its MCP features also surface which customers asked for what, with ARR context (canny-docs-4). Missing for 10: explicit evidence that a PM can manually attribute captured feedback (e.g., from Gong, Intercom or Slack via Autopilot) to a specific customer after the fact, plus independent or hands-on corroboration.
